units.source_text: 这天参观金阁的游客约莫上百人，

en.t: That day, there were roughly over a hundred visitors touring the Golden Pavilion,

units.source_text: 六点半将闭馆，人流也已临近退潮。

en.t: and since it would close at six thirty, the flow of people was already beginning to ebb.

units.source_text: 老人挂完电话，向导的工作就结束了。

en.t: Once the old man hung up the telephone, his work as a guide was finished.

units.source_text: 他茫然地位立在厨房东侧的土间里，眺望着小小的菜园。

en.t: He stood blankly in the earthen-floored area on the east side of the kitchen, gazing out at the small vegetable garden.
